q: Cooking food by submerging it in boiling water (at 100°C) is called ____. (P4)
explain: Boiling cooks tubers, rice, and eggs thoroughly in water.

q: Cooking food in hot cooking oil or fat in a pan is called ____. (P4)
explain: Frying (deep or shallow) crisps foods quickly at high heat.

q: Cooking food in dry heat inside an enclosed oven (e.g. bread, cake, pies) is called ____. (P4)
explain: Baking utilizes hot convective air inside an oven.

q: Cooking food gently using the vapor steam rising from boiling water below without touching the water is ____. (P4)
explain: Steaming preserves delicate vitamins and flavors in foods.
